reference_inspection.observed_decision_canvas: 33x32 RGBA review copies with centered compact silhouettes and transparent corners; decision_cat 114x101 references were not used.

reference_inspection.reference_role: style and native-canvas review only; no canonical PNG was used as source or construction input.

processing.resize: Pillow Lanczos fit into exact native canvas with transparent padding; decisions fit within 31x30 on 33x32; ideas fit within 58x66 on 60x68.
processing.dds_format: uncompressed 32-bit BGRA/B8G8R8A8, one level, no mipmaps

checks: DDS legacy header fields and exact byte length
